title: Tenant pre-deploy verifier and GPU prober for private installs
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: build an idempotent pre-deploy verification orchestrator that runs a concise set of checks before a Private (VPC) installation. The verifier will consume Terraform outputs (network IDs, service account ARNs, region/sku hints) and perform live probes and API validations to catch common failure modes: cloud quotas, IAM permission gaps, DNS delegation mistakes, and GPU SKU availability/soft-quotas.

Scope and constraints:
- Must work for AWS and GCP first; design pluggable adapters for other cloud providers and on-prem probes.
- Integrate with existing IaC modules so customers can run the verifier as a CI gate or as a one-off preflight job.
- Produce machine-readable results (JSON) and a human-friendly summary with remediation steps.
- Support two modes: shallow (fast checks using API/quotas) and deep (network-level probes, test instance boot to validate GPU SKUs).
- Air-gapped/private control plane consideration: verifier needs an offline mode that validates local Terraform state and emits warnings instead of live API calls.

Acceptance criteria:
1) A CLI job (or container) that reads terraform outputs and returns non-zero exit on blocking failures (quotas exhausted, missing IAM roles, DNS delegation not found, 0 available GPUs for requested SKU).
2) A documented Terraform module hook (example in examples/ directory) demonstrating how to wire verifier output into CI gating.
3) Deep-probe flow validates at least one GPU SKU per region by provisioning ephemeral instance/driver probe in a sandboxed account and safely tearing it down.
4) Emit standardized JSON with fields: check_id, status, severity, message, remediation. (Log schema documented in Confluence link below.)
5) Unit/integration tests covering mocked quota APIs and an integration smoke run against a staging cloud account.

Out of scope for this ticket: policy-driven auto-remediation (will be follow-up), RBAC/UI console integration (separate PM ticket).
comments: 2026-03-01 - Triage: flagged as P1 by Infra PM (R. Lopez). Rationale: multiple recent customer installs failed at scale due to unnoticed quota and GPU SKU mismatches.
2026-03-03 - Design sync: decided to keep verifier cloud-adapter pluggable. Marcus to prototype AWS/GCP adapters. Asha to write Terraform hook docs. Action: sketch CLI API and JSON schema.

2026-03-05 - Spike results: prototype can fetch AWS service-quotas and GCP compute quotas; initial GPU probe uses g4dn/p4d SKU IaaS flow. Observed inconsistent quota names across accounts; will normalize by using resource metadata + allow account-specific overrides.

2026-03-07 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/private-preflight/pull/14 - adds AWS adapter and basic quota checks. Requesting review from infra-team. CI currently failing on integration smoke run (timeouts mounting device drivers in the deep probe).

2026-03-09 - Blocker noted: certain customer air-gapped installs cannot reach cloud quota APIs. Added 'offline' validation mode to emit advisory warnings rather than hard-blocks. Follow-up ticket needed to add secure proxy agent for offline accounts.

2026-03-10 - Testing: ran verifier in staging against test tenant (staging-account-42). Shallow checks caught a 0 remaining GPUs for requested p4d SKU in us-west-2; remediation suggested: choose alternate region or request quota increase. Deep probe succeeded for g4dn but failed for p4d due to ephemeral driver install timing; added 2-minute retry window.

2026-03-11 - Next steps: finish GCP adapter, add example Terraform hook, resolve PR feedback from infra-team, schedule runbook write-up for support engineers. Plan to demo to Solutions Eng on 2026-03-17.
